provider.priorEvidence: A prior separately authorized private five-second call retained an 81,729-byte MP3; that consumed authorization is not reused.

callPlan.precondition: An exact immutable CNY quote for this request must be returned before transport execution; unknown, zero, foreign-currency or above-ceiling pricing fails closed.
callPlan.idempotency: The commercial job key derives a stable :music provider key.
callPlan.transportStatus: Not wired to production. The local service accepts only an injected server-side quote function and transport after explicit enablement.

assetAndBinding.renderProvenance: Generated music and reviewed captions are included with provider image/video/voice ids in render.metadata.sourceArtifacts.

mixing.policy: speech-first mix with music gain and ducking from the reviewed composition plan
mixing.ordering: Music must succeed and be retained before compose; no uploaded tone or placeholder fallback is permitted.

failureAndRollback.quoteFailure: No provider call and no new asset.
failureAndRollback.providerFailure: One failed call maximum, retryable=false, sanitized error, no fallback and no compose.
failureAndRollback.mediaValidationFailure: Reject returned bytes; do not retain or compose.
failureAndRollback.revisionDrift: Artifact sink or composition rejects stale identity.
failureAndRollback.rollback: Existing assets, timeline and prior render remain unchanged because composition starts only after successful music retention; production deployment rollback is a later separately reviewed action.

acceptancePlan: Review exact official endpoint/resource id and account-visible price/quote mechanism without exposing credentials.
Wire the disabled service into server quote, durable job and browser UI behind explicit real-music selection and confirmation.
Run local negative and recovery tests with zero network calls.
Request separate approval for one private five-second SeedAudio call, maximum CNY 10, zero retries.
Only after retained real MP3/WAV inspection, request deployment approval and then a separately bounded final ordinary-account production acceptance.
Final evidence must show audible generated music, provider/model/job/usage, revision identity, full render sourceArtifacts, mix parameters, Chinese captions and playable MP4.
